// diagnostic E2824

Jet.ServerCodeUsesBrowser

`{method}` runs on the server, as `{marker}` marks it, but it uses the `Browser` effect, which only the page has.

What

`{method}` runs on the server, as `{marker}` marks it, but it uses the `Browser` effect, which only the page has.

Why

An endpoint, a job, a schedule, a webhook and a signing key run their bodies on the server, and the `Browser` effect (the page's DOM, its local and session storage and its events) exists only in the page, so the server can never make the call.

Fix

Do the `Browser` work in the page, in a screen or a `#Target(JS)` function, and keep `{method}` to work the server can do.

Worked example
